commit.message:
Fix security vulnerabilities in nokogiri, puma and concurrent-ruby (#132)

* Fix security vulnerabilities in nokogiri, puma and concurrent-ruby

bundler-audit reported 16 advisories across three gems. All are now
resolved.

- Update nokogiri from 1.19.2 to 1.19.4, resolving 11 advisories,
  including GHSA-jrqx-8g72-6r5r (High: ReDoS in the CSS selector
  tokenizer), several possible use-after-free and out-of-bounds read
  issues, and GHSA-v2fc-qm4h-8hqv (Medium: XSLT transform memory leak).
  Gemfile floor raised to >= 1.19.4.
- Update puma from 7.0.4 to 8.0.2, resolving CVE-2026-47736 and
  CVE-2026-47737 (both High: PROXY protocol v1 remote memory exhaustion
  and acceptance of repeated protocol headers on persistent
  connections). Gemfile floor added at >= 8.0.2.
- Update concurrent-ruby from 1.3.5 to 1.3.8 (transitive via
  sentry-ruby), resolving 3 advisories covering ReentrantReadWriteLock
  read-count overflow, wrong-thread write release, and an
  AtomicReference#update livelock.

nio4r 2.7.4 -> 2.7.5 came along as a puma dependency.

Puma 8 is a major bump, so beyond the specs (which only use rack-test)
the app was booted under it directly to confirm it starts and serves
requests. Nothing here configures puma beyond the bind address, so the
PROXY protocol changes in the advisories do not affect this setup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Add changelog entry for the security dependency updates

Records the nokogiri, puma and concurrent-ruby updates under an
Unreleased heading, per the Keep a Changelog format this file follows.
Left as Unreleased rather than a new version number so the release and
version bump stay a separate, deliberate step.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Bump version to 2.13.1

Releases the security dependency updates as a patch version, replacing
the Unreleased changelog heading with a dated 2.13.1 entry.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
